purpose: Manufacturer-original Saab WIS engine-code crosscheck over source-compiled eligible U.S. Saab 9-3/9-5 production groups; links existing engine rebuild risk issues without changing them.

source_records.title: 9-3 9400 MY2000 factory VIN engine and gearbox identification
source_records.notes: VIN position 7 8=automatic 4-speed and position 8 N=B204L, H=B205L, K=B205R. Code table describes identities, not proof any arbitrary option combination was ordered in every year.

source_records.title: 9-3 9400 MY1999 B204L/E/R turbo intake system
source_records.notes: MY1999 WIS explicit B204L/E/R engine family, not MY2000+ B205 label.

source_records.title: 9-3 9400 MY2001 B205L/R torque power graph
source_records.notes: MY2001 WIS describes 185hp B205L and 205hp B205R. Does not establish original gearbox case or a VIN identity.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2004 B207L/R factory power graph
source_records.notes: B207L 175hp and B207R 210hp; manufacturer workshop platform code. Unrelated non-US B207E and convertible-only B207S not US candidate additions.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2008 factory VIN transmission/body/engine code table
source_records.notes: VIN position 6 4=sedan,5=five-door,7 9=automatic five-speed FWD or 1=six-speed automatic FWD, engine at pos8 S=B207L,Y=B207R,U=B284L. Actual 2008 original VIN not available.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2006 original B284L V6 engine number decoding
source_records.notes: WIS engine-number pattern B284L; engine number pos7 A=automatic, unlike handbook demonstration M=manual. Does not verify engine number on an actual U.S. V6.

source_records.title: 9-5 9600 MY2000 factory engine management system variants
source_records.notes: Original WIS engine sections identify B235E/R and B308E. B235L added later and should not be projected backwards.

source_records.title: 9-5 9600 MY2004 original factory VIN code table
source_records.notes: Original VIN position7 9=5-speed auto, position8 A=B235L,E=B235E,G=B235R; also position6 4=sedan/5=five-door. This is year-specific.

source_records.title: 9-5 9600 MY2004 B235E/L/R factory engine technical data
source_records.notes: B235E/L/R specified, including 220hp B235L. Broad WIS includes non-US high-output special engines, not automatically U.S. factory variants.

source_records.title: 9-5 9650 MY2011 factory VIN identifies 2.0T A20NFT/LHU
source_records.notes: VIN pos8 Z=2.0T A20NFT/LHU; R=2.0T A20NFT/LHU BioPower. pos7 A=FWD six-speed auto; model year 2011 pos10 B. US production table uses generic 2.0T, not original position8, so code is a factory-supported candidate pending real VIN.

source_records.title: U.S./Canada Saab bulletin 210-2554 ed.3 timing-chain noise and oil sludge
source_records.notes: Manufacturer June 2006 TSB market explicitly US/CA; affected 9-5 M98-03 B205/B235 and 9-3 9400 M99-03 B205/B235 only. Symptom-conditioned checks. Lower bearing damage triggers short block replacement in bulletin. Do not extend to B204, B207, 2004+ 9-5, V6 or all cars.

source_records.title: Saab bulletin 210-2417 ed.4 MY98-03 9-5 B205/B235 crankcase ventilation
source_records.notes: Bulletin April 2006 market all, 9-5 MY98-03 B205/B235; PCV limited flow and oil leaks; Saab PCV renovation kit. Not proof all candidate vehicles have had kit or are sludge-free.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2006 B207 general data incl minimum compression
source_records.notes: 2006 WIS min compression 12.4 bar and controlled specifications; no cold-start-specific model-year threshold inferred.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2005 B207 factory mechanical diagnostic menu
source_records.notes: Lists factory compression test, oil pressure check, timing/balance chains; these procedures do not establish inherent failure probability.

source_records.title: 9-3 9440 MY2006 B284 chain-driven camshaft engine architecture
source_records.notes: Confirms two chain-driven camshafts per cylinder bank and cam phasing; does not claim high chain failure incidence.

source_records.title: 9-5 9650 MY2011 LDK/LHU timing chain check
source_records.notes: Factory timing check with EN-49212 tool and defined chain alignment, not a high-frequency failure report.

source_records.title: 9-5 9650 MY2011 LDK/LHU engine mechanical misfire/noise diagnosis
source_records.notes: Factory diagnosis topics separate misfire with noise vs no noise, coolant and oil consumption, compression. Not a quantified fleet failure curve.

2011 U.S. compiled production label 2.0T lacks VIN character; Saab 2011 VIN chart gives A20NFT/LHU, but must inspect actual VIN code Z/R and engine stamp.

signals: timing or balance shaft chain rattling
recommended_evidence: service history and appropriate oil/PCV records
do not run engine with suspected oil starvation or bearing damage; qualified professional mechanical oil-pressure verification
chain tensioner measurement and oil pickup sump inspection only after safe evaluation
if lower-end damage suspected, inspect bearing condition via factory procedure and price short block vs walk-away
screening_topics.decision_rule: A proven damaged crank/rod/main bearing is a no-rebuild project-car exclusion unless the buyer explicitly accepts replacement-engine costs; mere oil leak or chain noise does not establish bearing damage.
not_claimed: PCV upgrade guarantees no bearing wear
2004+ B235 or B204 are included in this US/CA bulletin

signals: external oil seepage from timing cover/front seal area
recommended_evidence: verify actual VIN and original PCV configuration
review PCV renovation kit history rather than assuming it was done
separate fluid leaks from measured low oil pressure or bearing damage
screening_topics.decision_rule: Treat PCV system as service research and history, not confirmation of current internal engine condition.
not_claimed: a PCV kit repairs already worn bearings

recommended_evidence: controlled cylinder compression/leakdown to model/year original procedure
separate spark/fuel/ECM failures from actual intake-valve sealing loss
check oil pressure by factory procedure if symptoms justify it
do not crank a seized, coolant-filled or mechanically suspect nonrunning engine
screening_topics.decision_rule: Do not buy a non-running 9-3 on the assumption cold misfire is only ignition or only valve damage; mechanical measurements decide.
not_claimed: all B207 versions share the same failure prevalence
the 2006 min compression applies at any temperature to every year

signals: poor starting or timing correlation faults, if documented on actual car
recommended_evidence: verify factory engine number and codes, maintenance history, mechanical condition
establish a model-year and VIN-matched fault guide before asserting timing chain needs repair
screening_topics.decision_rule: A chain-driven V6 is not proof of a defective chain; do not invent repair prices or probabilities.
not_claimed: a B284 timing chain defect is established by this source
B284L and B207 timing systems share parts

recommended_evidence: decode actual VIN position 8 and engine stamping, distinguish 2.0T gas/BioPower
follow MY2011 model-specific mechanical diagnostic tree and special-tool timing-chain verification when symptoms justify
screening_topics.decision_rule: Do not project older B235/B207 maintenance failures or parts onto 2011 A20NFT/LHU, nor diagnose a chain from noise alone.
not_claimed: every U.S. 2011 Turbo4 is VIN Z regardless of evidence
factory proves a high failure rate for chain system

signals: high-cost mechanical damage possible on any poorly stored nonrunning V6
recommended_evidence: VIN-confirm B308E and obtain original V6 service procedures before diagnosing its components
screening_topics.decision_rule: Do not transfer four-cylinder B235 sludge PCV or part diagnosis to B308E V6.
not_claimed: B308E inherently worse or better than B235
V6 is covered by B205/B235 sludge bulletin

hard_rules: No automatic approval of interchange, engine reliability or original production option pairing from workshop code lists
No diagnosis by sound or DTC alone; use controlled WIS and physical vehicle evidence
B205/B235 US/CA 210-2554 bulletin only for original Saab 9-3 MY99-03 B205/B235 and original 9-5 MY98-03 B205/B235; not B204, B207, B284, B308 or later 9-5
MY2011 9-5 Turbo4 production engine abbreviation 2.0T must not be silently treated as a photographed VIN; 2011 Saab WIS code A20NFT/LHU is candidate identity, check car first
Saab manufacturer WIS directory may contain later editions or markets other than U.S.; source/year alone is not 110 VIN authentications
